defs.def: the process of cutting open a part of a person's body in order to remove or repair a damaged part 手术

ex.s: B: Yes, well, a five-hour operation is pretty (tire).
ex.t: B：是的，嗯，一场五小时的手术确实很（累人）。

defs.def: an organized activity that involves several people doing different things （有组织的）活动，行动

ex.s: This marked one of the final stages of a top-secret operation that had been months, perhaps years, in the planning.
ex.t: 这标志着一项绝密行动的最后阶段之一，这项行动已经规划了数月，甚至可能是数年。

ex.s: Code-named “Operation Overlord”, it was the largest combined sea, air and land operation in history, the aim being to free north-west Europe from German occupation.
ex.t: 代号＂霸王行动＂，这是历史上最大规模的海陆空联合作战，目的是将西北欧从德国占领下解放出来。

ex.s: After waiting for the perfect combination of weather, moon and tides, the date for the start of Operation Overlord was set for 6 June.
ex.t: 在等待了天气、月亮和潮汐的完美组合之后，霸王行动的开始日期被定在了6月6日。

ex.s: These operations have enabled scientists (better understand) geographical and biological conditions deep under the oceans.
ex.t: 这些行动使科学家能够（更好地理解）深海的地理和生物条件。

defs.def: a business or company involving many parts （包括许多部分的）企业，公司
the activity or work done in an area of business or industry （工商业）活动，业务
an act performed by a machine, especially a computer 运算；运作
the way that parts of a machine or a system work; the process of making sth work 运转；运行；操作

ex.s: A smoke detector is on the ceiling in your room． Some buildings also have heat detectors on the ceilings． Do the following to ensure the safe operation of your smoke detector：
ex.t: 烟雾探测器位于你房间的天花板上。有些建筑物在天花板上也设有热探测器。为确保烟雾探测器的安全运行，请做下列工作:

ex.s: （5）To ensure the safe operation of the smoke detector， one should     ．
ex.t: （5）为确保烟雾探测器安全运行，一个人应该____。

defs.def: a process in which a number or quantity is changed by adding, multiplying, etc. 运算
